policy.authorization: Learner chose prototype only: test rejection and report trade-off
policy.missing_rule: UNAVAILABLE if warning on/unknown, original predictor unavailable, or loss age > existing model horizon 10; otherwise original output
policy.real_rule: Always original MEASURED vector; warning never hides a received measurement
policy.rejected_values: Six float64 NaNs; original missing_run retained
policy.state: Advance original MLP and warning on every successful step using only received vector or None; rejected outputs never fed back
policy.prototype_limit: Original inference still computed before rejection; not an inference-time optimization
policy.startup: Original LOCF warm-up fallback remains; unknown warning rejects missing positions until two real observations
policy.full_validation: Saved sums on all 102 segments/four frozen masks, 3 residual seeds; gaps <=10 so same accepted set as saved unwarned group
policy.selection_limit: Segment0 ordinary correctness check; segment92 previously inspected failure; bounded correctness checks, not representative sampling
policy.correctness_acceptance: 10 synthetic tests; accepted values unchanged; rejected values NaN+UNAVAILABLE; all saved counts/sums reconcile; full replay audits on 24 fresh cases
policy.acceptance_limit: No application-specific error/coverage requirements agreed; no operational enablement or calibrated confidence claim
policy.no_tuning: Frozen warning thresholds, checkpoints, masks and normalization unchanged
